proposed_ledger_entry: Item 332 determines the global arithmetic meaning of Item 329's actual cubic carriers. With F(t)=(2-4t+3t^2-t^3)/2 and b_h=[t^(2h)]F(t)^(4h/3), it proves the exact characteristic-zero identity c_h^*=2(4h+3)b_h/3. On every actual row, 2^(-4M)K_(M,2h)=b_h mod p, with all denominators and prefactors p-units, so the original collision-forced K zero is exactly the already pinned c_h^* zero. Writing psi=F^(2/3) and T=x psi(T), the full diagonal has generating function xT'/T on the fixed degree-six curve 4T^3=x^3P(T)^2; under t=y/(1+y), t/psi(t) is exactly Item 237's old algebraic parameter. The dual carrier also collapses: j_s=-3A_s exactly, J=j_s mod p, and 2^(-4M)L=-3X_s+(4h+3)b_h mod p, recovering the old opposite Item-308 factor. Thus normalizing and reducing the K/J/L exponent parameters cannot create a new independent period or codimension. The exact diagonal's sequence-specific weighted zero density remains open. A bounded set of fixed targets is zero-rate, while componentwise algebraic height over the growing target family gives only O(M^2). Booking is zero and the fixed-j1 ceiling remains 1/36 per 6M.
